items.title: Better HTTP/1 connection reuse in Go 1.27
items.summary: The latest release of Go 1.27 introduces improved HTTP/1 connection reuse, enhancing performance for web applications. Developers should adopt this update to optimize their applications' network efficiency and reduce latency.

items.title: Banks are now trying to offload the AI data center debt they just underwrote
items.summary: Financial institutions are seeking to divest from AI data center investments due to rising operational costs and market volatility. This trend could impact future AI development funding and infrastructure availability.

items.title: Pg_vectorsearch: An index that is faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW
items.summary: The new pg_vectorsearch index offers significant speed improvements over existing vector search methods in PostgreSQL. This advancement is crucial for developers working with large-scale data retrieval and machine learning applications.

items.title: AI agents aren't 'going rogue.' Frontier labs are skipping security basics
items.summary: A recent analysis reveals that many AI agents are not malfunctioning but rather are a result of inadequate security measures in development. This highlights the need for stricter security protocols in AI development to prevent potential misuse.

items.title: Show HN: Petal, open-source CoScreen/ScreenHero finally free
items.summary: Petal, an open-source alternative to CoScreen and ScreenHero, has been released for free, allowing developers to collaborate more effectively in real-time. This tool enhances remote work capabilities and fosters better team collaboration.
